name: Veigar
title: the Tiny Master of Evil

Q.name: Baleful Strike
Q.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.5/0.55/0.6/0.65/0.7×AP magic damage to the first two enemies hit. If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.
Q.summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

W.name: Dark Matter
W.description: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing 85/140/195/250/305 + 0.7/0.8/0.9/1/1.1×AP magic damage. Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.
W.summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

E.name: Event Horizon
E.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for 1.5/1.75/2/2.25/2.5 seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.
E.summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

R.name: Primordial Burst
R.description: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between 175/250/325 + 0.65/0.7/0.75×AP and (175/250/325 + 0.65/0.7/0.75×AP) × 2 magic damage, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
R.summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

Passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
Passive.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
Passive.summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Scaling burst mage who stacks Ability Power permanently from every spell hit and takedown. Controls fights with the E cage stun and finishes targets with a missing-health R execute.
strengths: E cage stuns anyone who walks through its edge for 1.5–2.5 s and zones choke points
Infinite AP scaling from passive: very strong late if he farms Q kills
R is a point-and-click execute that does up to double damage on low targets
Q pierces two targets, so he can last-hit and poke at once
Strong pick and anti-dive with E in teamfights
weaknesses: Weak early: low base damage and no mobility, easy to bully in lane
E is his only defensive tool; once it's down he has no escape
W is slow to land (delayed), so it mostly hits stunned or immobile targets
Short-range and immobile champions dive him easily when E is on cooldown

curve.lvl1: weak – Q only; stacking and farming focus
curve.lvl3: medium – E-W combo threatens if E lands
curve.lvl6: strong – R execute makes E+W+Q+R a kill combo
curve.items: strong – Luden's/Rabadon's; Lost Chapter for mana
curve.late: strong – passive stacks make every combo lethal

profile.curveNote: Needs E to land W reliably; before level 3 he farms Q stacks and avoids trades.
profile.waveClear: medium – Q two-target last hits, W area once ranked

Passive.notes: Permanent AP from spell hits and takedowns; more stacks = stronger W and R.

Q.notes: Hits first two enemies; kill gives extra stacks. Blockable by projectile blocks.

W.notes: Delayed area blast; easy to dodge unless the target is caged or slowed.

E.notes: Cage edge stuns 1.5–2.5 s; the inside is safe. Cage lasts 3 s.

R.notes: Point-and-click; damage rises with target missing health (double at low HP). Blocked by spell shields.

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown (14–20 s): he has no escape or peel. Early levels before his stacks build.
checks: Whether R counts as a projectile for Yasuo W / Samira W (it's a targeted missile).
